E-H1.statement: T1 and T2 STRICT on every checkpoint

E-H2.statement: T3, T4, T5 and F2 at least BOUNDED

analysis.note: A PR pass does not change P5's L or composite outcome. Analytical work counts and measured latencies are different quantities; nothing here is a quality claim.

selection.rule: tree: lowest W8 addition_forward geometric-mean ratio to T0 among EQ-passing T1-T5; flat comparator: lowest median-of-worker-medians W8 addition_forward among EQ-passing F0/F1/F2; ties to the lowest variant ID
